name: BeatForge
description: Generate beautifully syncronized levels from any song — auto-detects BPM and builds beat-mapped gameplay

level-prefix.name: Level Name Prefix
level-prefix.description: Prefix added before the song name for the generated level

difficulty.name: Target Difficulty
difficulty.description: How dense/challenging the generated patterns should be

length-seconds.name: Level Length
length-seconds.description: How many seconds of the song to generate (0 = full song)

use-bg-pulse.name: Background Pulse
use-bg-pulse.description: Add color-trigger pulse effects synced to the beat

platform-mode.name: Platformer Mode
platform-mode.description: Generate a platformer level instead of classic
